sentiment.summary: No congressional signal; market in fear (36 Fear/Greed) with bearish sentiment (41% bearish) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but lack of recent news data and stale congressional trades (194+ days old) limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe VIX crisis regime (384.8) combined with flat yield curve and approaching earnings (27 days) creates highly unfavourable macro conditions for REGN trading.
